name: manifest-template-and-requirements
changes: Added ModuleRequirements public Core model and implementation.
Extended ModuleManifest with manifestTemplateVersion, defaultModuleRole, and runtimeRequirements.
Added manifest 1.1 decoding while preserving 1.0 default decoding.
Extended the capability vocabulary and Core service interfaces.
Tightened capability-scoped service resolution to explicit service mappings.

Added manifest semantic validation for schema/template compatibility, duplicate capabilities, duplicate requirement/UI IDs, role/type rules, UI contract rules, I/O capability mapping, and data isolation consistency.
Corrected SemVer construction, parsing, JSON decoding, and prerelease precedence.
Migrated example module manifests and bundled example manifest providers to schema 1.1.
Updated README and framework policy manifest documentation.
testsAdded: Requirement enum round trips and unknown rejection.
Duplicate capability, I/O requirement, and UI ID rejection.
Service UI contract rejection and UI missing-contract rejection.
Semantic Versioning prerelease precedence and invalid-form rejection.

validation.command: python3 JSON parse over repository JSON files
rg legacy public-surface names excluding baseline evidence

knownLimitations: Native Windows/MSVC build, CTest execution, and PowerShell guardrail execution still require a Windows toolchain environment.
Registration, activation-time requirement enforcement, data wrappers, roles, and UI contribution contract enforcement continue in later phases.
